question: South Carolina Senate Special Republican Primary: First Round Winner
resolution_criteria:
The first round of the 2026 special Republican Party primary for the United States Senate election in South Carolina will be held on August 11, 2026, with a potential runoff on August 25, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the candidate that wins the most votes in the first round of the special Republican Primary for US Senator from South Carolina.

Candidates will be primarily ranked by the number of valid votes received in the specified election. If two or more candidates are tied on valid votes, ties will be broken by alphabetical order of the candidates' first names, as listed in this market group. This market will resolve to the candidate that occupies the highest finishing position after applying this ranking.

If the results of this election are not definitively known by December 31, 2026, this market will resolve to “Other.”

The primary resolution source for this market will be information from the State of South Carolina, such as official statewide results published by the South Carolina Election Commission (https://scvotes.gov/); however, an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.


"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
I found a clear picture of the race as of July 29, but nothing decides it yet. Interim Sen. Darline Graham Nordone has Trump's endorsement. The only public poll I could date before the cutoff had Ralph Norman narrowly ahead of her, with about a quarter of voters undecided. Many search results described the August election, so I left out everything published after 2026-07-29.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-07-13: The SC Election Commission (scvotes.gov) set filing from noon July 21 to noon July 28. The special Republican primary is Tuesday, August 11, with a runoff on August 25 if needed. The page lists no candidates and no results. [SCEC](https://scvotes.gov/u-s-senate-special-republican-party-filing-primary/)
- I found no official results or certified candidate list on scvotes.gov dated on or before 2026-07-29.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Filing closed 2026-07-28, and voting is August 11.
- 2026-07-11: Sen. Lindsey Graham died, which triggered the special primary for the Republican nomination. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_election_in_South_Carolina)
- Candidates who filed, according to news reports:
  - 2026-07-21: Duke Buckner, who has twice run against Rep. James Clyburn, filed on the first day. [WACH](https://wach.com/news/local/filing-opens-for-sc-gop-special-senate-primary-10440-fee-and-five-candidates-enter)
  - 2026-07-24: Nordone filed.
  - Also reported as filing: Ralph Norman, Russell Fry, Mark Sanford, Mark Lynch, Mark McBride, Clark Neilson and Samuel Shepherd. [PJ Media 07-23](https://pjmedia.com/jennifer-rust/2026/07/23/roundup-of-the-race-for-sc-senate-new-candidates-a-debate-pro-life-controversy-on-x-n4955393)
- **Sheri Biggs:** I found no evidence that she filed or is running. She was mentioned only as the House member for Graham's home district. [Fox Carolina 07-15](https://www.foxcarolina.com/2026/07/15/lindsey-graham-remembered-dc-possible-candidates-senate-seat-surface/)
- Nancy Mace is not running and endorsed Norman. [FITSNews](https://www.fitsnews.com/2026/07/22/s-c-succession-second-u-s-senate-poll-shows-ralph-norman-leading/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-29: Coverage says Trump's endorsement "wasn't enough to clear the field" for Nordone. [BizPac Review](https://www.bizpacreview.com/2026/07/29/trumps-endorsement-wasnt-enough-to-clear-the-field-for-lindsey-grahams-sister-1652595/)
- 2026-07-22: Innovative Communication Strategies poll (July 20-21, 788 likely voters, ±3.5, not paid for by any campaign):

  | Candidate | Share |
  |---|---|
  | Norman | 18.6% |
  | Nordone | 16.3% |
  | Fry | 11.7% |
  | Lynch | 8.6% |
  | Mace (not running) | 6.5% |
  | Pamela Evette (undecided on running) | 5.6% |
  | Sanford | 5% |
  | Undecided | 26.3% |

  [FITSNews](https://www.fitsnews.com/2026/07/22/s-c-succession-second-u-s-senate-poll-shows-ralph-norman-leading/)
- 2026-07-21: Electoral-vote.com reported that Nordone had announced her campaign. Norman, Fry, Lynch and Buckner were running, and Evette was still deciding. [electoral-vote.com](https://www.electoral-vote.com/evp2026/Items/Jul21-3.html)
- 2026-07-17: Trump posted on Truth Social urging Nordone to run ("RUN, DARLINE, RUN!") and promised his "Complete and Total Endorsement." A strategist said Trump's endorsement has carried less weight than expected in recent SC races. Trump had earlier floated Fry. [SC Daily Gazette](https://scdailygazette.com/2026/07/17/president-donald-trump-encourages-sen-darline-graham-to-seek-full-six-year-term/), [Post and Courier](https://www.postandcourier.com/politics/trump-darline-graham-endorsement-senate-run/article_fc4c69c1-a31c-4603-b7c3-c22cc007db6e.html)
- Mid-July: Emerson's first poll (July 14-15) tested a hypothetical field:

  | Candidate | Share |
  |---|---|
  | Norman | 16% |
  | Lynch | 13% |
  | Evette | 10% |
  | Mace | 10% |
  | Fry | 9% |
  | McMaster | 8% |
  | Nordone | 6% |
  | Sanford | 5% |
  | Undecided | 18% |

  [Emerson](https://emersoncollegepolling.com/south-carolina-2026-poll-no-clear-leader-to-replace-late-sen-graham-on-ballot/), [Mediaite](https://www.mediaite.com/politics/first-poll-on-south-carolina-senate-race-for-lindsey-grahams-seat-shows-runoff-is-likely/)
- 2026-07-13: Gov. McMaster appointed Nordone, Graham's sister, as interim senator at Trump's recommendation. Tim Scott and John Thune endorsed her. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/13/backed-by-trump-lindsey-grahams-sister-darline-will-replace-him-in-senate)

## 4. Base rates
- I found no directly comparable base rate. Two things are relevant:
  - Trump-endorsed candidates usually do well in red-state GOP primaries. [electoral-vote.com](https://www.electoral-vote.com/evp2026/Items/Jul21-3.html)
  - In SC specifically, Trump's pick lost: Sheri Biggs beat Trump-backed Mark Burns in the 2024 SC-3 runoff. [WLOS](https://wlos.com/news/local/sheri-biggs-wins-republican-house-south-carolina-over-mark-burns-trump-backed-candidate-gov-henry-mcmaster)
- In a crowded field with about 26% undecided, a runoff is widely expected, so the first-round leader could win with a low plurality.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Aggregator snapshots show Nordone around 71% on Polymarket's first-round winner market, Norman about 16% and Fry about 5%. I could not confirm that these prices were from on or before July 29. [Prediction Hunt market page](https://www.predictionhunt.com/odds/south-carolina-republican-senate-special-primary-1st-place-1st-round/29981)
- 2026-07-19: After Norman entered, the market odds of Republicans holding the seat fell from 83% to 52%. [Prediction Hunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/news/gop-odds-to-hold-sc-senate-seat-fall-31-points-jul-19-2026)
- I found no expert ratings for the primary.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The final candidate list and ballot certification. Other candidate names appear in later reporting, and the field could still change before the vote.
- More polling. Emerson and Trafalgar both appear to have polled in late July or early August, but I could not confirm any release on or before July 29.
- Televised GOP debates, including a Nexstar debate on August 4. [WSAV](https://www.wsav.com/news/local-news/south-carolina-news/wsav-nexstar-to-host-gop-u-s-senate-debate-aug-4-ahead-of-south-carolina-primary/amp)
- Possible campaigning by Trump for Nordone, and Mace's backing for Norman.
- The primary itself on August 11.
